gone: This link can't be opened. It may have ended or been closed by the teacher.
rateLimited: Please try again in a little while.
error: The link couldn't be opened. Please try again shortly.
headline: {name}'s card study
coverSlot: Space for a warm header picture
masteryHint: It grows as cards are answered right on different days.
practiceHint: These cards were the trickiest. Read them aloud and say the meaning together.
practiceNone: No tricky cards yet. Keep going like this.
practiceHidden: A test is in progress, so the practice cards will show once it ends.
noteDefault: Card by card, steady progress. Talking about today's cards at home once more helps a lot.
privacy: This link holds this student's record only. Other students and class rankings are never shown.
linksIntro: A read-only link that shows one student's study on this set. It opens without signing in and stops at once when it ends or you close it.
linksShows: Shown: the name as you choose, mastery, required study, test scores, tricky cards and your note. No other students, class rankings or Bomal.
notePlaceholder: Left empty, a default greeting shows.
revokeAllConfirm: Close every open parent link for this set? People who have them can no longer open them.
replaceNote: Making a new link closes that student's previous one.
createdHint: Links show only now. Once this closes they can't be shown again, so copy or print them. If one is lost, make a new one.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please select and copy it yourself.
rewardToggle: Give Bomal for card study in this class
rewardRule: Once per assignment: {study} for first finishing the required study, {goal} for first reaching the test goal. Never for game scores, reviews or retries.
rewardSeparate: Bomal is kept apart from grades. It is not in report scores or parent links.
rewardPointsOff: Bomal & dress-up is off for this class, so nothing is given yet.
rankToggle: Show the class ranking to students
rankRule: Off (the default): students see only their own best. On: they also see the class top ten and their rank. You always see the full ranking.
rankInline: Review games · applies to the whole class right away
